	anim_player.name = "AnimationPlayer"

	anim_player.owner = root

		lib.add_animation(name, anim)

	var anim_tree = AnimationTree.new()
	anim_tree.name = "AnimationTree"
	root.add_child(anim_tree)
	anim_tree.owner = root
	anim_tree.anim_player = NodePath("../AnimationPlayer")
	anim_tree.active = true

	var state_machine = AnimationNodeStateMachine.new()
	anim_tree.tree_root = state_machine

	var locomotion = AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D.new()

	locomotion.add_blend_point(AnimationNodeAnimation.new(), Vector2(1, 0), 4) # walk_east
	state_machine.add_node("Locomotion", locomotion)

	# Attack (AnimationNodeAnimation)
	var attack = AnimationNodeAnimation.new()
	attack.animation = &"attack"
	state_machine.add_node("Attack", attack)

	# Transitions
	state_machine.add_transition("Locomotion", "Attack", "condition_attack")
	var t2 = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.new()
	t2.switch_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.SWITCH_MODE_AT_END
	state_machine.add_transition("Attack", "Locomotion", t2)

	state_machine.start_node = "Locomotion"

	var controller = Node.new()
	controller.name = "PlayerAnimController"
	controller.set_script(load("res://scripts/PlayerAnimController.gd"))
	root.add_child(controller)
	controller.owner = root

	scene.pack(root)
	ResourceSaver.save(scene, "res://scenes/Player.tscn")
	print("Scene built")

@tool
extends EditorScenePostImport

func _post_import(_obj: Object) -> Object:
	return null

static func build() -> void:
	var scene = PackedScene.new()
	var root = CharacterBody2D.new()
	root.name = "Player"

	var anim_player = AnimationPlayer.new()
	anim_player.name = "AnimationPlayer"
	root.add_child(anim_player)
	anim_player.owner = root

	var lib = AnimationLibrary.new()
	var anims = ["idle", "walk_north", "walk_south", "walk_east", "walk_west", "attack"]
	for name in anims:
		var anim = Animation.new()
		anim.length = 1.0
		anim.loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_NONE
		anim.add_track(Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
		anim.track_set_path(0, NodePath(".:modulate"))
		anim.track_insert_key(0, 0.0, Color.WHITE)
		anim.track_insert_key(0, 1.0, Color.WHITE)
		lib.add_animation(name, anim)
		anim_player.add_animation_library("", lib)

	var anim_tree = AnimationTree.new()
	anim_tree.name = "AnimationTree"
	root.add_child(anim_tree)
	anim_tree.owner = root
	anim_tree.anim_player = NodePath("../AnimationPlayer")
	anim_tree.active = true

	var state_machine = AnimationNodeStateMachine.new()
	anim_tree.tree_root = state_machine

	var locomotion = AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D.new()
	locomotion.add_blend_point(make_anim("idle"), Vector2(0, 0), 0)
	locomotion.add_blend_point(make_anim("walk_north"), Vector2(0, -1), 1)
	locomotion.add_blend_point(make_anim("walk_south"), Vector2(0, 1), 2)
	locomotion.add_blend_point(make_anim("walk_west"), Vector2(-1, 0), 3)
	locomotion.add_blend_point(make_anim("walk_east"), Vector2(1, 0), 4)
	state_machine.add_node("Locomotion", locomotion)

	var attack = AnimationNodeAnimation.new()
	attack.animation = &"attack"
	state_machine.add_node("Attack", attack)

	var t1 = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.new()
	t1.advance_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.ADVANCE_MODE_ENABLED
	t1.advance_condition = &"condition_attack"
	state_machine.add_transition("Locomotion", "Attack", t1)

	var t2 = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.new()
	t2.switch_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.SWITCH_MODE_AT_END
	state_machine.add_transition("Attack", "Locomotion", t2)

	state_machine.set("start_node", "Locomotion")

	var controller = Node.new()
	controller.name = "PlayerAnimController"
	controller.set_script(load("res://scripts/PlayerAnimController.gd"))
	root.add_child(controller)
	controller.owner = root

	scene.pack(root)
	var err = ResourceSaver.save(scene, "res://scenes/Player.tscn")
	print("Scene built. Error = ", err)

static func make_anim(name: StringName) -> AnimationNodeAnimation:
	var n = AnimationNodeAnimation.new()
	n.animation = name
	return n
